definitions.name: O1B.RED
definitions.note: one pass deleting adjacent () and [] pairs from a bracket String

definitions.name: O1B.REDALL
definitions.body: O1B.RED O1B.RED O1B.RED O1B.RED O1B.RED O1B.RED
definitions.note: reduce a bracket String of at most 12 characters to its unmatched remainder

definitions.name: O1B.BAL
definitions.note: TRUE when a bracket String (at most 12 chars) is balanced

definitions.name: O1B.BALPRE
definitions.body: 'BS' BIND 0 BS CHARS LENGTH RANGE 'BR' BIND BR 0 BR [ 'BK' BIND BS CHARS BK TAKE JOIN O1B.BAL ] MAP SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: length of the longest balanced prefix of a bracket String

definitions.name: O1B.LEDGER
definitions.body: ZIP 'LZ' BIND LZ 0 GET LZ 1 GET G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries to Record name to summed amount, first-appearance order

definitions.name: O1B.RUNS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT RV CONCAT -1 DROP 'RB' BIND RV RB SUB 'RD' BIND RD RD MUL 1 MIN 0 [ ADD ] SCAN RV GROUP VALUES
definitions.note: Vector of integers to Vector of its maximal runs of equal adjacent values, each a Vector

definitions.name: O1B.MISSING
definitions.note: Vector with NILs to Vector of 1 for each NIL lane and 0 for each present lane

definitions.name: O1B.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value of a number, lifts over Vectors

definitions.name: O1B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers

solutions.brackets.depth: '[' '(' REPLACE ']' ')' REPLACE CHARS [ 'CH' BIND 1 -1 CH '(' EQ SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.debtors: O1B.LEDGER 'LR' BIND LR KEYS LR VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LE' BIND LE LE ZIP 1 GET G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: LOWER G0A.WORDS [ G0B.CAP ] MAP G0B.SPACED
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'PW' BIND PW PW [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.rle: O1B.RUNS [ 'RG' BIND RG 0 GET RG LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'UV' BIND UV 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT UV CONCAT -1 DROP 'UB' BIND 1 UV UB SUB 0 MAX 1 MIN SUB 0 [ ADD ] SCAN UV GROUP VALUES [ LENGTH ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.majority: 'MJ' BIND MJ TALLY 'MT' BIND MT VALUES 'MC' BIND MC G0A.ARGMAX 'MI' BIND MT KEYS MI GET NIL MC MI GET 2 MUL MJ LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.sensor.filled: 'FV' BIND FV FV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'SE' BIND 'SA' BIND SA SE SE NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: O1B.MISSING 'GM' BIND GM [ 0 ] GM CONCAT -1 DROP SUB 0 MAX G0A.SUM
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: O1B.MISSING 0 [ 'RE' BIND 1 ADD RE MUL ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'RT' BIND RT 1 DROP RT -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'SV' BIND SV SV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER G0C.MAXV 'SM' BIND SV [ 'SX' BIND NIL 1 SX SX NIL? SELECT SM DIV SX NIL? SELECT ] MAP
solutions.series.mad: 'AV' BIND AV O1B.MEDIAN 'AM' BIND AV AM SUB O1B.ABS O1B.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'MW' BIND MW -2 DROP MW 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MW 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'RM' BIND RM RM 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
